Levels from RuneLite


Link your levels?


You've just levelled Thieving, so RuneLite has now made your screenshots folder (.runelite/screenshots/<RSN>). Link it and the guide ticks level requirements off by itself and warns you before you hit one you're missing.

Needs RuneLite's Screenshot plugin with Levels (and Quests) turned on.
